item.subject: science
item.stem:
Multiple choice question: Meena sees a plant growing near the wall of her school garden in Jaipur. It is not very tall, has many hard, woody brown stems that branch out close to the ground, and has no single main trunk. Which of the following statements about this plant is correct ( )
A. It is a tree, because its stem is hard and woody
B. It is a shrub, because it has many woody stems branching near the ground
C. It is a herb, because it is not very tall
D. It is a climber, because it is growing near a wall

options.A: It is a tree, because its stem is hard and woody
options.B: It is a shrub, because it has many woody stems branching near the ground
options.C: It is a herb, because it is not very tall
options.D: It is a climber, because it is growing near a wall
